title: STEER-BENCH: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Steerability of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Steering models using instruction-response demonstrations from contrasting political subreddits (e.g., AskALiberal vs. AskConservatives) and evaluating alignment using community-specific multiple-choice questions.

Steering models using instruction-response demonstrations from contrasting gender-focused subreddits (e.g., AskWomen vs. AskMen, Feminism vs. MensRights) and evaluating alignment using community-specific multiple-choice questions.

Steering models using instruction-response demonstrations from contrasting religious subreddits (e.g., atheism vs. Christianity, exmuslim vs. islam) and evaluating alignment using community-specific multiple-choice questions.

Steering models using instruction-response demonstrations from contrasting lifestyle, interest, and social subreddits (e.g., diet, parenting, technology, sports) to evaluate alignment with distinct community norms and viewpoints via multiple-choice questions.
